format: rows are the replica's rows for one zone: recordName, state (acknowledged, or pendingCreate for a row created locally and not yet acknowledged) and serverModifiedAt (ms of the server modification date the replica holds, null for a pending create). walk is a names-only walk of the zone (desiredKeys = []): when it began and the names it returned. expect.delete lists, sorted, the rows to delete as inbound deletions: every row the walk did not return, except pending creates and rows whose serverModifiedAt is later than walk.startedAt.
status: Seed set written with WP1; WP5 adds the cases for deterministic re-creates gated on the last complete pass (§6.2).

cases.name: a row the walk did not return is deleted as an inbound deletion
every row the walk returned is kept
a row created locally and not yet acknowledged is kept although the walk missed it
a row modified on the server after the walk began is kept
a row modified exactly when the walk began is deleted (only later rows are kept)
